groups.title: A　to V 還是 V-ing

items.q: We plan ______ the supplier next month.
items.note: plan 指向未來 → to V。

items.q: Thank you for ______ the drawing so quickly.
items.note: 介係詞 for 後面只能 -ing。

items.q: We finished ______ all the samples yesterday.
items.note: finish 面對「這件事本身」→ V-ing。

items.q: We look forward to ______ your PO.
items.note: look forward to 的 to 是介係詞 → -ing。

items.q: Remember ______ the report before you leave.（記得要去寄）
items.note: 還沒寄、要去寄 → to V。remember sending 是「記得寄過」。

items.q: Please see the file ______ to this email.
The manager made us ______ the test.
We asked the supplier ______ the invoice.
We had the samples ______ by a third-party lab.
items.note: have + 物 + V-ed = 請人把它測好。

groups.title: C　中翻英
groups.hint: 寫完檢查：第二個動作穿對衣服了嗎？

items.a: We need to confirm the quantity first.

items.q: 我打電話是要確認時程。
items.a: I called to confirm the schedule. / I'm calling to confirm the schedule.
Thank you for sending the quotation.

items.q: 我讓團隊去查一下這個問題。
items.a: I'll have the team look into it. / I'll ask the team to look into it.
items.note: have + 人 + 原形；ask + 人 + to V。

items.q: 這個延遲讓人很煩，客戶很不高興。
items.a: The delay is frustrating, and the customer is unhappy.
